name: Elestrals Beyond
summary: Enter Elestrals Beyond. This is a new “sandbox-style” digital client custom-built for Elestrals TCG. This has been developed by the talented team at NetDeck.gg to create a curated and streamlined experience for playing. The client is built to be highly responsive, efficient, and adaptable to whatever game state you come up with. And it’s 100% free and always will be.
